doc:
H: a talk-only prompt (no movement doctrine, no walking/obstacle advice,
no map sections) makes the same choice when Maren is 2 m away and when a
stranger is in view — so splitting the prompt by job is safe here.

samples.message: Hiya Maren! What a fine day for chatting!
samples.thought: I am at the village square as scheduled, and Maren is right here talking to someone; I should say hello!

samples.message: Hiya Maren! How's the veggie doing today?
samples.thought: I am at the village square and Maren is right here, so I will say hello to her as planned.
